history.summary: Efficient 775 sqft 2BR at Eco Sanctuary, a large 2016 D23 leasehold near Bukit Panjang. Priced well below median at $1,548 psf vs $1,628 (~5% under), with a solid 4.0%/yr resale CAGR on a deep 108-txn base and a liquid $1.2M quantum — but the 1.12km LRT walk is its weakest point.
history.rating_rationale: Sub-median PSF entry ($1,548 vs $1,628 median), a reliable 4.0%/yr resale CAGR on a robust 108-txn series, an efficient (not oversized) 775 sqft 2BR, and a sweet-spot $1.2M quantum that keeps the buyer pool deep. Eco Sanctuary is a large development (~483 units) supporting liquidity. The 1.12km walk to Pending LRT is the main drawback, but the value and appreciation case is strong. Score 586.
red_flags: 1.12km to Pending LRT — poor walkability and LRT (not MRT) connectivity
OCR Bukit Panjang location with limited direct catalysts
catalysts: Sub-median PSF leaves clear value headroom
Bukit Panjang DTL/LRT interchange connectivity in the wider area
